notes: VELSTRIA ステージの 2D 素材（2026-10-12 の作り直し「遺跡と森」セット。旧セットは stage_art.json）。画風: 古代の石の遺跡と豊かな自然が共存し、建築に魔力が残る世界。スタイライズドなセミリアル。石 = 重く風化した灰緑の花崗岩（艶なし・欠け・苔）、金属 = 暗い古びた青銅、光るのは結晶とルーンだけ。色は深緑・青緑・灰色の石・くすんだ土。tile はシームレス化を stage_bake.py で行うので多少の継ぎ目は許容。concept は Tripo の image-to-3d（tools/stage/stage_tripo.mjs）に渡す。

styles.tile: Seamless tileable top-down ground texture, square, viewed straight from above (orthographic, no perspective, no horizon), evenly and flatly lit (no lighting direction, no cast shadows, no highlights). Art direction: high-end stylized semi-realistic MOBA terrain (painterly but physically grounded materials, like a premium modern mobile MOBA; neither photoreal nor cartoon). World theme: ancient stone ruins coexisting with lush nature. Palette: deep forest green, blue-green, grey-green granite, muted earth brown; matte surfaces. Detail at several scales but no large single feature, uniform density everywhere so it tiles seamlessly on all four edges. No text, no border, no vignette, no frame.
styles.concept:
Art direction: high-end stylized semi-realistic MOBA environment art (painterly but physically grounded PBR materials, like a premium modern mobile MOBA; neither photoreal nor low-poly, not cartoon). World theme: ancient stone ruins coexisting with lush nature; the old architecture still holds residual magic. Priority: silhouette > large light/shadow masses > material separation > mid-scale forms > fine details. Materials: STONE = heavy weathered grey-green granite with thick chamfered edges, chipped corners, angular fractured planes, thick soft moss and lichen on top surfaces and in crevices, matte (never shiny); METAL (only if mentioned) = dark aged bronze with restrained low-gloss reflections and a little green patina; FOLIAGE = dense clusters of small leaves with irregular outlines, deep green and blue-green with sunlit yellow-green tips and darker teal undersides. Palette: deep forest green, blue-green, grey-green stone, muted earth brown. Light: one warm-neutral key light from the upper left, soft sky fill, clear form shadows and ambient occlusion in crevices that show thickness and weight.

Image type: single-object concept for image-to-3D. Show exactly ONE object, whole and uncropped with generous margin on all sides, centred, viewed three-quarter from above at about 45 degrees (like a MOBA game camera) so the top surfaces and the outline are clearly readable. Plain flat light-grey (#d8d8d8) background, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow on the background, no ground plane, no soil disc, no display pedestal, no grass patch around it.

Exclude: HUD, UI, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, people, characters, animals, unrelated extra objects, fog, smoke, sparks, particles, glow bloom or light rays, floating debris, uniform plastic shine, noisy micro-detail, over-ornamentation.

assets.use: 地面: 草地（ジャングル・レーン脇）
assets.prompt: Subject: short lush meadow grass mixed with small patches of low moss and a little clover: mostly mid deep-green with blue-green shadow pockets and muted yellow-green sunlit blade tips, fine readable blade strokes, a few tiny leaves, very few tiny pale flowers; calm, low contrast, so game characters standing on it stay readable.

assets.use: 地面: 森の下草（壁際・木陰・草むら下）
assets.prompt: Subject: dense forest-floor ground cover: thick dark green moss cushions, small fern fronds, low leafy undergrowth, a few fallen leaves and thin twigs; cooler, darker and more blue-green than an open meadow, soft value variation.

assets.use: 地面: レーンの土の道
assets.prompt: Subject: a packed earth footpath: compacted muted grey-brown soil with fine grit, small embedded pebbles and flat broken stone chips, faint smooth footworn areas, a few tiny roots and very sparse grass sprouts; muted earth tones (umber, grey-brown, a little dull ochre), not orange, not red, no cracked dry-mud plates, no wheel tracks.

assets.use: 地面: 拠点・祭壇・塔の台座まわりの石畳
assets.prompt: Subject: an old worn flagstone floor of an ancient ruin: irregular large weathered grey-green granite slabs of clearly varied sizes and shapes (not a regular grid), chipped and rounded edges, several slabs cracked, a few small missing corners filled with packed earth, fine dark joints with moss and tiny grass in them; subtle colour variation between slabs (cool grey, grey-green, faint warm grey), matte stone with fine granular speckle.

assets.use: 崖の芯の側面（三平面投影）
assets.prompt: Subject: a weathered grey-green granite cliff face seen straight on: large angular fractured planes and a few cracks, chipped edges, fine granular speckle, faint pale lichen spots and a little moss in the cracks, matte; no sky, no ground.

assets.use: 崖の芯の上面・岩の上の苔
assets.prompt: Subject: a thick soft moss carpet growing on stone: deep green and blue-green moss cushions with yellow-green sunlit tips, tiny leaves and small fern sprigs, a few small bits of grey stone peeking through.

Subject: a shallow clear riverbed seen from above: rounded grey-green and slate pebbles, flat stones and patches of fine pale sand, a little green algae on some stones, cool blue-green overall, no water surface reflections.

Object: a wide, heavy cliff rock block, about 2.2 times as wide as it is tall and roughly as deep as it is tall, shown with its long side facing the camera: one massive angular mass of weathered grey-green granite split by a few deep vertical and diagonal fractures into 3 or 4 big faceted chunks with flat sheared faces and chipped chamfered edges; the top is fairly flat and covered by a thick soft carpet of deep green moss that spills over the upper edges in irregular tongues, with a few small ferns and grass tufts on top; the stone gets darker and damper toward the bottom; the base is cut flat and broad as if the rock continues below the ground (a buried base: no rounded underside, no overhang at the bottom).

assets.use: Tripo: 壁の角の岩（縦長・柱状）
assets.prompt: Object: a tall angular rock outcrop: a tight cluster of three blocky weathered grey-green granite pillars of different heights standing close together (the tallest about 1.6 times as tall as the whole cluster is wide), sharp fractured planes, chipped edges and cracks, moss caps and small fern tufts on the flat tops and ledges, pale lichen patches on the sides; a broad base cut flat as if buried in the ground.

Object: a single medium boulder of weathered grey-green granite, angular and faceted (not round, not smooth), slightly wider than tall, two or three fracture lines and chipped edges, a thick moss cap on top that spills down one side, a little lichen; flat buried base.

Object: a broad-canopy deciduous tree: a short thick gnarled trunk with mossy bark and a few buttress roots gripping the ground, splitting into three heavy branches; a wide dome canopy (about 1.1 times as wide as the tree is tall) built from five or six large irregular clumps of dense small leaves with ragged, uneven outlines (not spheres, not cotton balls), deep green and blue-green with sunlit yellow-green tops and darker teal undersides, small gaps between clumps where branches show.

assets.use: Tripo: 背の高い木（外周の森）
assets.prompt: Object: a tall forest tree for a dense forest edge: a straight sturdy trunk with mossy dark bark and a few roots at the foot, a tall layered crown of several stacked irregular clumps of dense small leaves (like a tall linden or oak), deep green and blue-green with sunlit yellow-green tops and dark teal undersides; the crown is about 0.55 times as wide as the total height of the tree.

assets.use: Tripo: 低木・茂み（崖の上・地面の低い茂み）
assets.prompt: Object: a low dense shrub cluster about twice as wide as it is tall: several overlapping mounds of small broad leaves with an irregular lumpy outline and a few leaf sprigs sticking out, deep green and blue-green with yellow-green sunlit tips and darker interior, two or three tiny pale cream flowers; it sits directly on the ground with a flat underside.

assets.use: Tripo: 遺跡の折れた柱と壁の断片（ボスの巣のまわり）
assets.prompt: Object: a ruined fragment of ancient architecture: one thick fluted grey-green granite column standing on a square chamfered plinth, the shaft snapped off unevenly at about two-thirds of its original height with a rough fractured top; joined on its left side to a short broken piece of ancient wall made of three or four courses of large worn ashlar blocks (the wall is lower than the column and ends in a stepped broken edge); a dark aged bronze band around the column near its base; a thin carved rune line on the column with a faint pale teal residue; moss and small ivy creeping up the plinth and along the block joints, two fallen blocks lying at the foot. The whole fragment is about twice as wide as it is deep.

assets.use: Tripo: 泉（出撃地点）の遺跡の台座（チーム色の結晶は実行時に別に置く）
assets.prompt: Object: a circular ancient spawn sanctuary platform, wide and low (total height about one fifth of its diameter): a round dais of worn grey-green granite in two low concentric steps; the top floor is paved with large radial flagstones around a central round socket rimmed with dark aged bronze (the socket is EMPTY: no crystal, no orb, nothing above it); around the outer rim stand six short square stone posts evenly spaced (each about as tall as one third of the dais radius), each bound with a dark aged bronze band and topped with a small EMPTY bronze cradle (no crystal in it); thin carved rune grooves on the floor (not glowing); moss in the joints and on the outer step, chipped and worn edges. Seen from above it reads as a clean circle with six posts.
